# cycle_image_source (Data Source)

Looks up a Cycle image source by ID or by its human-readable identifier. Exactly one of `id` or `identifier` must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an image source by its human-readable identifier...
data "cycle_image_source" "by_identifier" {
  identifier = "nginx"
}

# ...or by its ID.
data "cycle_image_source" "by_id" {
  id = "651586fca6078e98982dbd90"
}

output "image_source_type" {
  value = data.cycle_image_source.by_identifier.type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the image source. Conflicts with `identifier`.
- `identifier` (String) The human-readable slug identifier of the image source. Conflicts with `id`. Identifiers are not guaranteed unique; the lookup fails if multiple image sources match.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the image source, if one has been set.
- `name` (String) The name of the image source.
- `state` (String) The current state of the image source.
- `type` (String) The type of images in this source (`direct`, `stack-build`, or `bucket`).
